47474-huts-in-hell.title: Huts In Hell
47474-huts-in-hell.creator: Daniel A. Poling
47474-huts-in-hell.description: A book by Daniel A. Poling. She drove ahead through the night with ports closed and not a signal showing. Under the stars, both fore and aft, marines watched in silence by the guns. Each man wore or had by him a life-preserver, and there was silence on the deck.

arxiv-2001-05854.title: A THEORETICAL STUDY ON A TWO-DIMENSIONAL FLAP-TYPE WAVEMAKER
arxiv-2001-05854.creator: Final Project
arxiv-2001-05854.description: Abstract A mathematical model for unidirectional wave generation explained in this study. The model consists of Laplace’s equation in the semi-infinite two-dimensional water interior, dynamic and kinematic boundary conditions at the free surface, lateral boundary condition on the wavemaker, and fixed wall at the bottom.

arxiv-2107-10936.title: Minimal Session Types for the π \pi -calculus
arxiv-2107-10936.creator: Alen Arslanagić, Jorge A. Pérez, Anda-Amelia Palamariuc
arxiv-2107-10936.description: Abstract Session types are a discipline for the static verification of message-passing programs. A session type specifies a channel’s protocol as sequences of exchanges. It is most relevant to investigate session-based concurrency by identifying the essential notions that enable program specification and verification.

arxiv-2209-04943.title: A census of OBe stars in nearby metal-poor dwarf galaxies reveals a high fraction of extreme rotators
arxiv-2209-04943.creator: A. Schootemeijer, D. J. Lennon, M. Garcia, N. Langer, B. Hastings, C. Schürmann
arxiv-2209-04943.description: Abstract The Early Universe, together with many nearby dwarf galaxies, is deficient in heavy elements. The evolution of massive stars in such environments is thought to be affected by rotation. Extreme rotators amongst them tend to form decretion disks and manifest themselves as OBe stars.

arxiv-2411-03154.title: JWST COMPASS: The first near- to mid-infrared transmission spectrum of the hot super-Earth L 168-9 b
arxiv-2411-03154.creator: Munazza K. Alam, Peter Gao, Jea Adams Redai, Nicole L. Wallack, Nicholas F. Wogan, Artyom Aguichine, Anne Dattilo, Lili Alderson, Natasha E. Batalha, Natalie M. Batalha, James Kirk, Mercedes López-Morales, Annabella Meech, Sarah E. Moran, Johanna Teske, Hannah R. Wakeford, Angie Wolfgang
arxiv-2411-03154.description: Abstract We present the first broadband near- to mid-infrared (3–12 μ \mu m) transmission spectrum of the highly-irradiated ( T eq \rm T_{eq} = 981 K) M dwarf rocky planet L 168-9 b (TOI-134 b) observed with the NIRSpec and MIRI instruments aboard JWST.

arxiv-2504-10805.title: The internal logic and finite colimits
arxiv-2504-10805.creator: William Troiani
arxiv-2504-10805.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by William Troiani. We describe how finite colimits can be described using the internal lanuage, also known as the Mitchell-Benabou language, of a topos, provided the topos admits countably infinite colimits. This description is based on the set theoretic definitions of colimits and coequalisers, however the translation is not direct due to the differences between set theory and the internal language, these differences are described as internal versus external . Solutions to the hurdles which thus arise are given.

arxiv-2506-23373.title: The monomial expansions for modified Macdonald polynomials
arxiv-2506-23373.creator: Emma Yu Jin, Xiaowei Lin
arxiv-2506-23373.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Emma Yu Jin, Xiaowei Lin. We discover a family 𝒜 \mathcal{A} of sixteen statistics on fillings of any given Young diagram and prove new combinatorial formulas for the modified Macdonald polynomials, that is, H ~ λ ​ ( X , q , t ) = ∑ σ ∈ 𝒯 ⁡ ( λ ) x σ ​ q 𝗆𝖺𝗃 ⁡ ( σ ) ​ t η ⁡ ( σ ) \tilde{H}_{\lambda}(X;q,t)=\sum_{\sigma\in\mathcal{T}(\lambda)}x^{\sigma}q^{\mathsf{maj}(\sigma)}t^{\eta(\sigma)} for each statistic η ∈ 𝒜 \eta\in\mathcal{A} .

arxiv-2510-09725.title: Science ouverte et collaborative pour l’élaboration d’un banc automatisé de caractérisation de pertes en commutation par opposition
arxiv-2510-09725.creator: Nicolas ROUGER 1, Luiz VILLA 2,3, Matthieu MASSON 1,4, Pauline KERGUS 1, Joseph KEMDENG 1, Lorenzo LEIJNEN 1,4, Jean ALINEI 3, Adrien COLOMB 1, Ayoub FARAH-HASSAN 2,3, Arnauld BIGANZOLI 1 1 Laplace, CNRS, INPT, Université de Toulouse, Toulouse, France. 2 LAAS-CNRS, Toulouse, France. 3 Owntech fondat
arxiv-2510-09725.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nicolas ROUGER 1, Luiz VILLA 2,3, Matthieu MASSON 1,4, Pauline KERGUS 1, Joseph KEMDENG 1, Lorenzo LEIJNEN 1,4, Jean ALINEI 3, Adrien COLOMB 1, Ayoub FARAH-HASSAN 2,3, Arnauld BIGANZOLI 1 1 Laplace, CNRS, INPT, Université de Toulouse, Toulouse, France. 2 LAAS-CNRS, Toulouse, France. 3 Owntech fondat. RESUME – La mesure des pertes en commutation des transistors de puissance s’effectue généralement par la mesure dite de double impulsion. La mesure par opposition de deux cellules de commutation constitue une méthode complémentaire, plus précise mais indirecte.

arxiv-2510-23880.title: TRELLISWorld: Training-Free World Generation from Object Generators
arxiv-2510-23880.creator: Hanke Chen Yuan Liu Minchen Li
arxiv-2510-23880.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hanke Chen Yuan Liu Minchen Li. Text-driven 3D scene generation holds promise for a wide range of applications, from virtual prototyping to AR/VR and simulation. However, existing methods are often constrained to single-object generation, require domain-specific training, or lack support for full 360-degree viewability. In this work, we present a training-free approach to 3D scene synthesis by repurposing general-purpose text-to-3D object diffusion models as modular tile generators.

arxiv-2601-20637.title: An Empirical Investigation of Neural ODEs and Symbolic Regression for Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2601-20637.creator: Panayiotis Ioannou, Pietro Liò, Pietro Cicuta
arxiv-2601-20637.description: Abstract Accurately modelling the dynamics of complex systems and discovering their governing differential equations are critical tasks for accelerating scientific discovery. Using noisy, synthetic data from two damped oscillatory systems, we explore the extrapolation capabilities of Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (NODEs) and the ability of Symbolic Regression (SR) to recover the underlying equations. Our study yields three key insights.

pmc-10650446.title: Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound Follow-Up for Acute Pyelonephritis Patients
pmc-10650446.creator: Andrea Boccatonda, Stefano Venerato, Damiano D’Ardes, Giulio Cocco, Cosima Schiavone, Susanna Vicari, Atsushi Irisawa, Luk Hsiang Ning
pmc-10650446.description: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) is increasingly used in clinical practice as the first diagnostic method in patients with suspected pyelonephritis rather than abdominal CT with contrast medium, especially in young subjects. We performed a retrospective analysis on patients in for whom a CEUS examination was utilized as a follow-up method after acute pyelonephritis as normal clinical practice.

pmc-10709308.title: Inflammatory burden, lifestyle and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: insights from a population based cohort study
pmc-10709308.creator: Benjamin Bay, Christopher Blaum, Caroline Kellner, Ramona Bei der Kellen, Francisco Ojeda, Julia Waibel, Natalie Arnold, Christian-A Behrendt, David L Rimmele, Goetz Thomalla, Raphael Twerenbold, Stefan Blankenberg, Birgit Zyriax, Fabian J Brunner, Christoph Waldeyer
pmc-10709308.description: The inflammatory burden as measured by high-sensitivity C-reactive Protein (hsCRP) is recognized as a cardiovascular risk factor, which can however be affected by lifestyle-related risk factors (LRF). Up-to-date the interplay between hsCRP, LRF and presence and extent of atherosclerotic disease is still largely unknown, which we therefore sought to investigate in a contemporary population-based cohort.

pmc-10732867.title: Retracted: Traditional Chinese Medicine Moxibustion in the Treatment of Infantile Diarrhea
pmc-10732867.creator: Computational Intelligence and Neuroscience

pmc-11337014.title: Ultrafast photophysics of para-substituted 2,5-bis(arylethynyl) rhodacyclopentadienes: thermally activated intersystem crossing†
pmc-11337014.creator: Zilong Guo, Yaxin Wang, Julia Heitmüller, Carolin Sieck, Andreas Prüfer, Philipp Ralle, Andreas Steffen, Petr Henke, Peter R. Ogilby, Todd B. Marder, Xiaonan Ma, Tobias Brixner
pmc-11337014.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). 2,5-Bis(phenylethynyl) rhodacyclopentadienes (RCPDs), as a type of Rh(iii) complex, exhibit unusually intense fluorescence and slow intersystem crossing (ISC) due to weak metal–ligand interactions. However, details on their ultrafast photophysics and ISC dynamics are limited. In this work, electronic relaxation upon photoexcitation of two substituted RCPDs with two –CO2Me (A-RC-A) or –NMe2/–CO2Me (D-RC-A) end groups are comprehensively investigated using femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy and theoretical analysis.

pmc-11440912.title: Enzyme-armed nanocleaner provides superior detoxification against organophosphorus compounds via a dual-action mechanism
pmc-11440912.creator: Kang Qin, Fei Meng, Dianpeng Han, Wengeng Guo, Xinyi Li, Ziming Li, Lianqun Du, Huanying Zhou, Hongyuan Yan, Yuan Peng, Zhixian Gao
pmc-11440912.description: By inhibiting acetylcholinesterase (AChE) activity, organophosphate compounds (OPs) can quickly cause severe injury to the nervous system and death, making it extremely difficult to rescue victims after OP exposure. However, it is quite challenging to construct scavengers that neutralize and eliminate these harmful chemical agents promptly in the blood circulation system.

pmc-11603692.title: Identification of a machine learning-based diagnostic model for axial spondyloarthritis in rheumatological routine care using a random forest approach
pmc-11603692.creator: Imke Redeker, Styliani Tsiami, Jan Eicker, Uta Kiltz, David Kiefer, Ioana Andreica, Philipp Sewerin, Xenofon Baraliakos
pmc-11603692.description: ObjectivesIn axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA), early diagnosis is crucial, but diagnostic delay remains long and diagnostic criteria do not exist. We aimed to identify a diagnostic model that distinguishes patients with axSpA from patients without axSpA with chronic back pain based on clinical data in routine care.

pmc-12472998.title: Modulation of Macrophage Polarization by Traditional Chinese Medicine in HFpEF: A Review of Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potentials
pmc-12472998.creator: Chunqiu Liu, Jinfeng Yuan, Peipei Cheng, Tao Yang, Qian Liu, Tianshu Li, Chuyi Li, Huiyan Qu, Hua Zhou
pmc-12472998.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is a multifactorial cardiovascular disorder characterized by diastolic dysfunction, systemic inflammation, and myocardial fibrosis. Emerging evidence indicates that macrophage polarization imbalance plays a central role in HFpEF pathogenesis. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has demonstrated therapeutic potential in modulating macrophage activity through pathways such as NO/cGMP/PKG, TGF-β/Smads, and PI3K/Akt, thereby exerting anti-inflammatory, antifibrotic, and antioxidant effects.

pmc-12962615.title: Preclinical assessment of GNEwt/bi-shRNA-GNEM743T lipoplex product development for GNE myopathy
pmc-12962615.creator: Fabienne Kerneis, Christopher M Jay, Donald Rao, Jeremy Winchester, Alexander Nemunaitis, Emily Nemunaitis, Ernest Bognar, Gladice Wallraven, Laura Stanbery, Adam Walter, Sep Sarshar, John Nemunaitis
pmc-12962615.description: AimsGNE myopathy is a heredity disease of unmet medical need associated with progressive skeletal muscle wasting, atrophy and weakness caused by mutations in the GNE gene. GNE plays a pivotal role in sialic acid production. Sialic acid is a critical part of glycoprotein, ganglioside and glycolipid cell-cell interaction which is necessary for normal skeletal muscle function.

pmc-13220514.title: MIND-NL diet adherence moderates the relation of low-grade systemic inflammation with neuroinflammatory metabolites and cognitive functioning: an exploratory cross-sectional study in older adults
pmc-13220514.creator: Lianne B Remie, Mark R van Loenen, Mara PH van Trijp, Ilke GS de Lange, Yannick Vermeiren, Jurriaan J Mes, Nicolaas A Puts, Joukje M Oosterman, Esther Aarts
pmc-13220514.description: BackgroundObservational studies have linked high adherence to the “Mediterranean-Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension Intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay” (MIND) diet to improved cognitive functions in older adults. The underlying peripheral and central mechanisms of this association remain poorly understood, although multiple nutrients in the MIND diet are known for their anti-inflammatory effects.

pmc-13520076.title: Hearing thresholds above age- and sex-based norms and an under-recognized hearing screening gap in short-haul truck drivers in Los Angeles, California: a cross-sectional pilot study
pmc-13520076.creator: Rosemelly Jimenez Medal, Donald Jimenez, Sai Venkat Mandalapu, Erica D Walker
pmc-13520076.description: ObjectiveTo characterize hearing, noise behaviors, and awareness of hearing difficulty in predominantly Hispanic/Latino short-haul truck drivers, and to compare measured thresholds with age- and sex-based norms.MethodsIn this cross-sectional pilot study we studied 50 short-haul truck drivers in Los Angeles, California, USA, in July 2023.

pmc-13611464.title: A 1.5-GS/s 12-bit 58.9-dB SNDR Pipelined ADC with Weight-Regulated Dither-Based Interstage Gain Error Calibration
pmc-13611464.creator: Shang Xu, Zheng Zhang, Daolin Zhang, Guoan Wu, Lamin Zhan
pmc-13611464.description: This paper presents a novel weight-regulated, dither-based hybrid dual-stage background calibration technique for interstage gain errors (IGEs) in pipelined analog-to-digital converters (ADCs). To evaluate IGEs, a 1-bit pseudorandom dither is first injected into the first three stages. The proposed algorithm then evaluates IGEs via correlation.
